definitions.explanation: The designated time frame during which applications, entries, or submissions are accepted. Used for jobs, contests, enrollment, and various programs.

examples.japanese: {募集期間|ぼしゅうきかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧です。
examples.english: The application period is until tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {募集期間|ぼしゅうきかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦されました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The recruitment period has been extended.

examples.japanese: {募集期間|ぼしゅうきかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧しまった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: I missed the application period, so I have no choice but to wait for the next opportunity.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧ (recruitment; solicitation) + ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (period; time frame). Frequently seen on websites, posters, and official announcements. The word is essential for navigating applications in Japan — from job hunting to contest entries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {募集期間|ぼしゅうきかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: extend the application period
- {募集期間|ぼしゅうきかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}する→終了する：22990_shuuryousuru⟧: the application period ends
- {募集期間|ぼしゅうきかん}{内|ない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: apply within the application period
- {募集期間|ぼしゅうきかん}{外|がい}: outside the application period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: application period — nearly synonymous, slightly more focused on the applicant's action
- ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: acceptance period — emphasizes the receiving side
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧: deadline — the end point rather than the full time span
